Nurakkir is a crashed necropolis in the House of Eyes region of north-central Maldraxxus. It served as the headquarters of the House of Eyes and their ruler, Margrave Akarek, until it was destroyed in an explosion caused by the House of Rituals. Mor'Bitan the lich was involved in the event, as was his underling Mephiles the Loyal. Before its collapse, the necropolis was maintained by four soulbound individuals. Two of them—Whisperer Vyn and Navigator Xennir—survived the crash, but the mechanic and helmsman did not. The slime river known as Akarek's Tears flows out of Nurakkir's carcass. The area is now filled with scavengers from the House of Constructs seeking to salvage parts from the wrec

Noxious Moths are found in a few locations of the Mauler's Outlook of Korthia. Interact with one to pick it up and gain a temporary ability for five minutes: : Before using it, ensure there are no hostiles between the targeted shardhide and the central Precarious Silk Nest tree, as entering combat will cause the player to dismount. Target any shardhide in the area, then run the shardhide into the tree holding the Precarious Silk Nest. The force of the collision will knock it out of the tree, spawning the Dislodged Nest on the ground, one of the Treasures of Korthia.
Oath of the Elder Druid is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Elder Druid.
Nulia is a tuskarr flight master located at Apex Canopy in the Waking Shores.
Nuana is a furbolg located on Longclaw Island in the Azure Span.

Nullifier Transport Relay would be the result of repairing a Smashed Transport Relay with a Hyperbolic Circuit, a Transference Disc, and an Energy Cell. The repaired item would then be used to summon the Mechagonian Nullifier at Junkwatt Depot on Mechagon Island.

Obsidian Eradicators are mobs inside the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. They pull singly. They can drain mana from all mana users in range. It seems that they choose 16 candidates to drain mana from as soon as aggro is acquired. They will cast an area effect Shock Blast on everyone within 30 yards (6.5K nature damage) if their mana is allowed to reach 100%, so they must be drained of their mana with Mana Burn, and Drain Mana. Viper Sting (hunter ability) is not recommended as a mana drain, because it will take up valuable Debuff real estate, even if you only have 3 warlocks and 3 priests draining his mana. Viper Sting is simply not needed. An Obsidian Chunk will fall to the ground near the slain Obsid

Two Obsidian Nullifiers come with 1 Anubisath Warder in a pack in pulls after Twin Emperors and before C'Thun. Like all other Obsidian mobs in AQ, they have an ability that is triggered when they reach full mana, and they reach full mana by draining it from the raid.

Objects are parts of the in-game world, represented by graphic models. Objects are either permanently fixed in place, permanent spawns (such as specific quest objects) or random spawns (such as chests). Spawning objects may disappear after use or death, although they may respawn in the same place later. ;Types of objects: *Landscape objects - large objects like towers, buildings, or city walls that provide environment, essentially becoming part of the terrain *Fixed device, or fixed object - neither mobile nor spawned. A device can generally be used. *Spawned object - not mobile *mob, or mobile object - also spawned *Location objects - landscape, fixed, or spawned object (possibly mobile as

Observers (or floating eyes) are an intelligent race of demons resembling floating eyeball squids. They are originally native to the Great Dark Beyond. Looking through the Twisting Nether, observers have the capability to see through forms of stealth and invisibility.
Obsidian Power Source drops from Obsidian Sentinel in Uldaman.
Obliterate is a Frost death knight ability that allows the death knight to deal high damage. It is a staple in the arsenal of Frost death knights.
Obsidia's Egg is an egg among eggs that if used with 35 will call down Obsidia. The egg can be found in Obsidia's Perch in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Obris was one of Ner'zhul's higher ranking of officers. He served and helped unite the clans once again to fight the Alliance. His faith in Ner'zhul's role as savior of the Horde seemed to have been rather high, as he stood by and helped open the portals to new worlds. It was Ner'zhul's promise that the orcs would be saved, through the opening of such gateways to richer realms to conquer. Obris was witness to the breaking of Ner'zhul's nobility, when the old orc said that the rest of the Horde be damned, and that all that mattered was his own survival. Obris protested, but was mowed down by his master's magic and left for dead. Obris survived the assault, and in a final act of vengeance, gav

The Obsidian Sanctum is the black dragonflight area of the Chamber of Aspects. The entrance is in under the Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight and accessed via a crack in the ice following the Path of the Titans. It holds one raid boss, Sartharion the Onyx Guardian, and his three drake lieutenants, Shadron, Tenebron, and Vesperon. Raiders may choose to kill all three drakes or leave some combination of them alive. Completing the encounter with one or more drakes up increases both the difficulty and the quality of loot that drops. A 10 and 25-player version of this raid exists.

Originally just a lowly skeleton, Obrahiim, the Traveler quickly rose through the ranks of the Scourge to become one of the Archlich Kel'Thuzad's most trusted advisors. A brilliant architect, he played a pivotal role in the conception of Naxxramas, and was the mastermind behind the creation of Acherus. Always the scholar, Obrahiim traveled the world in search of knowledge, notably taking most of his early inspiration from nerubian architecture and the magics of the orcish warlocks. Always striving for more knowledge, he disappeared several years ago after leaving to study the ruins of Zin-Azshari, and is considered a hero by the Scourge.
Oathsworn Skinners are level 83-85 tol'vir found in Uldum and the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
Oathsworn Scorpid Keepers are level 85 elite tol'vir found in Lost City of the Tol'vir.
Oathsworn Wanderers are level 85 tol'vir found in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
Obsidian Colossus is an obsidian destroyer located at the Ruins of Khintaset in Uldum.
Observer Owls are owls seen flying in the Incursion in Krasarang Wilds.
Observant Inquisitors are inquisitors found in Suramar City in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Obsidian Overlook is a cliff overlooking Suramar found on Greystone in Highmountain. It is the entrance to the Slave Enclave of Neltharion's Vault.

The Obliterum Forge is a forge built by the demon hunters in Dalaran in which can destroy epic items in order to gain Obliterum Ash, which can be combined in order to create Obliterum. Archmage Karlain initially stands near the forge in order to give Fire it Up (before 7.2.0) or Firing Up the Forge (after 7.2.0) and teach its usage.
__NOTOC__ The Obsidian Deathwarder is located in the Slave Enclave of the Path of Huln cave in Highmountain.
Obsidian Bite is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Obsidian Annihilator is an obsidian destroyer located in Uldum.
Obsidian Overlord is a black dragonspawn located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Obsidian Prophet is a dragonspawn located in Island Expeditions.

Observer Yorik is a rare-elite soul seeker located in The Rift of Korthia. An objective of Shaping Fate and Conquering Korthia, enter a Rift Portal on the Vault of Secrets island, then find the soul seeker near the center of the vault. Yorik hits like a truck and scales up to raid-boss levels of health, so bring a group including a tank and a healer! Yorik also drops ~75x Relic Fragment and ~6x rare-quality anima items (210 Reservoir Anima). Yorik may also drop the Maw-Ocular Viewfinder, the Choker of the Hidden Observer, and Rift Splitter. Unlike the Screaming Shade or the Silent Soulstalker, everyone attempting to kill Yorik must use their own Repaired Riftkey to enter the Rift. ;Spawn :

Observer Ongrax is a darkglare that can spawn in Mythic+ Legion timewalking for the Black Rook Hold, Court of Stars, Darkheart Thicket, Eye of Azshara, Neltharion's Lair, and Vault of the Wardens dungeons with the Infernal (affix) affix.
Obedience is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Obedient.

Obsidian Rest is the forward post of the Valdrakken Accord and Wrathion's Blacktalon on the way to Aberrus in northern Zaralek Cavern. The accord has set up in a ruined tower, bordered by Brimstone Garrison to the north and west, and Slitherdrake Roost to the south. Keskos, the flight master, has connections to the Dragonscale Camp and Loamm. Uphill to the east of the rest at , a Bronze Timekeeper starts the Brimstone Scramble dragonriding race.

Obsidian Aspectral Earthstone is an achievement reward from Dragonflight Season 2 Hero.
Obsidian Gladiator's Slitherdrake is an achievement reward from Gladiator: Dragonflight Season 2.

Oblivion's Immortal Coil drops from Scalecommander Sarkareth in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.

The off hand (or off-hand) is the secondary hand slot for weapons (dual wielding), shields, or other items that you are able to wield or equip. The other hand is known as the main hand. How to tell if an item can be used in the off hand: * Information about an item will tell you if it can be used in the off hand. ** For those with dual wield capability, weapons identified as main hand cannot be used in the off hand slot. Only weapons identified as one-hand or off hand can be used in the off hand slot. Off hand items cannot be used in the main hand slot. Weapons equipped in the off hand generally do 50% less damage than they would do when equipped in the main hand, and many players equip spee
Of Blood and Honor is a novella by Chris Metzen taking place in the Warcraft universe.
Ocean's Breeze is the final reward from the Hydraxis quest chain.
Officer Maloof is an Alliance Commendation Officer located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. He offers reputation with Stormwind in exchange for Alliance Commendation Signets.
Officer Gothena was a Forsaken quest giver located in the Trade Quarter in Undercity.
Officer Vu'Shalay was a jungle troll quest giver located in the Valley of Wisdom in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.
.]] Obsidian statues are constructs used by the Scourge that can transform into obsidian destroyers. At least three immobile obsidian statues can currently be found in Ahn'Qiraj.

Octopi are ocean-dwelling cephalopods. The ink from octopi is used for writing. Octopus meat takes some getting used to, but some night elves like to eat the whole thing while it's still alive. It's impossible to catch octopi with a fishing line. Mimic octopi aren't as rare as one might think because they use camouflage to hide amongst rocks and plants. Even in death, mimic octopi continue changing color to blend in with their environment.

Ogre Archaeology Fragment are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Ogre archaeology sites, and drop from an Ancient Ogre that sometimes spawns when digging.

The Offering to Ram'Pag is looted from the Actually Safe Treasure Chest on the summit of Reflection Peak in Highmountain.

Ocean Tarot is crafted with Inscription (1); taught by Draenor Inscription (item). Required tools: *Virtuoso Inking Set
Ogdrul is a drogbar located at Den of the Seeker in Trueshot Lodge of Highmountain. He wields a bow that looks like Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers.
The Offering to An'she was obtained by draining the magic from the Offering to An'she.
Official-Looking Note is found on the second floor of Lakeshire Inn in Redridge Mountains.

Occult Emitter is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Obsidian Warders is a weyrn charged with defending the allies of the black dragonflight and protecting its strongholds. Whether it is deployed to reinforce draconic legions or guard the skies alongside dragons, this weyrn is the embodiment of the Earth-Warder's aegis. Currently under the authority of the Scalecommander Azurathel, the Warders trained to be the bulwark that enemy forces will break upon. After Raszageth's attack, this weyrn was forced to evacuate the Forbidden Reach with the help of Wrathion, Ebyssian, and Nozdormu. Guided by Wrathion they headed to Stormwind to warn the other races of Azeroth and soon after joined the Alliance.
__NOTOC__ Ogdan Stoneforge is a dwarf located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.
Occulus is an elite drake found in Tanaris. He is part of the bronze dragonflight, guarding the entrance to the Caverns of Time.
The Oceanside Feast is located at the Hissing Grotto in the Waking Shores. The food has no special properties, but will restore both health and mana and doesn't run out.
Officer Obernax is a red drakonid flight master located at the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus.

The Obsidian Throne is located in western Waking Shores. It is the apex of the Obsidian Citadel and holds the eponymous throne. It acts as the headquarters of the Blacktalon and Obsidian Brood as they battle to reclaim the rest of the Citadel and Neltharus from the Djaradin. Adventurers can arrive here and pledge their loyalty to either Sabellian and his faction or Wrathion and his faction weekly. In doing so, they lend support for which of the two prospective heirs should lead the black dragonflight as the new Aspect.
Obsidian Skin is a pet ability available exclusively to the core hound family of hunter pets, reducing pet damage taken by 50%.
Obsidian Sentry is a rotating cannons located in the Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. It is found near the Empowering Flame.
Ocean Grey Ear Warmer is sold by Murik and Omapurita in the Azure Span for .
Occarim is a green dragonspawn flight master located in Verdant Landing in Emerald Dream.
Ogunaro Wolfrunner is a wolf vendor located in the Hunter's Hall of the Valley of Honor, in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.
Oil tankers are ships used to transport crude oil from oil platforms out in the ocean to oil refineries on the main land to be processed into useable oil.
__NOTOC__ Ohura is a draenei flight master located at Sun's Reach Harbor on the Isle of Quel'Danas. She is standing next to Ayren Cloudbreaker.
Olakin's Torch is provided as an objective for By Fire Be Purged. It is used to destroy Festering Corpses found in the abomination lab or Sanctum of Reanimation in the Fleshwerks area of Icecrown.

Ogre Minions are the simple-minded followers and servants of the giant, deadly ettin, . They are responsible for the attack on the Gilnean stagecoach caravan that destroyed two of the coaches, leaving the stranded in Hailwood Marsh. The Ogre Minions can be found patrolling the base of the hill and winding trail that leads up to Koroth's Den in Gilneas.
Ol' Beaky is a parrot that can be found on a small island within the Ironclad Cove in the Deadmines.
Ol' Gummers is a great white shark found in Lake Everstill of the Redridge Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Ol' Irongoat is a dwarf blacksmith located at the Windshear Hold in Stonetalon Mountains. He is the one who wrote the STAY OUT! sign.
Ogre Moonshine is created with Ogre Brewing Kit, but can also be found in Gorr'thogg's Personal Reserve.

Oil Patches are concentrated areas of oil found in most water-based maps in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness and Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal. An oil platform can be built on top of these areas by both Alliance and Horde that will allow a friendly oil tanker to extract the precious black substance and haul it back to an allied shipyard for resource collection. Oil patches are important resource nodes for building and maintaining a strong navy during the game. Large pools of this highly flammable substance are found far beneath the surface of the sea. Special platforms must be constructed in order to drill deep enough into the ocean floor to get at this sticky, black substance. Dark oily

Oku is an orc or night elf (depending on the race of the player) warrior that is a part of the Uber Town group. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.
__NOTOC__ Ol' Big Tusk is a boar located on Mechagon Island.

Ogre Runestones are runestones located at the Darkmaul Citadel on Exile's Reach. The ogres are using three of them to hold Captain Kelra or Warlord Mulgrin Thunderwalker captive for use as a ritual sacrifice. The runestones are powered by ward stones, which are held by some of the ogres' warriors.
Ogundimu's Fist is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The ohuna (sometimes called wind eagles) are a race of eagles native to the Dragon Isles. They are mainly found in the Ohn'ahran Plains, but also in Thaldraszus and the Forbidden Reach. All ohuna are descended from Ohn'ahra, the Wild God of the Wind. The Maruuk centaur consider ohuna to be sacred, and it is forbidden to harm them. The birds' shed feathers contain small bits of wind magic and are used as reagents in many centaur rituals. The Maruuk use ohuna as messenger birds. Clan Shikaar uses them as hunting companions, but their relationship is transient and built on mutual respect, as the eagles do not answer to the centaur, but to the sky. Each spring, an ohuna chooses a new hunter to a

The Ohn'ahran Plains storyline is the second chapter of the Dragonflight campaign.
Oiled Feathers is one of the pet abilities that only waterfowl can use.

]] Old Ironforge, also known as the Assembly of Thanes, is a chamber deep below the High Seat of the dwarven capital of Ironforge. In an effort to aid the troubled elementals that foreshadowed the Cataclysm and the return of Deathwing, King Magni Bronzebeard opened a part of the old city and attempted a titan ritual to commune with the earth but was turned into diamond. He stood rooted on what has become known as Magni's Dais. A long and winding path leads over the lava to the two doors of Aegrim's Study. While Old Ironforge has always been present in-game, its entrance was originally closed off until Cataclysm.

Omusa Thunderhorn was a tauren wind rider flight master located in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. During the Alliance attack on Camp Taurajo, Omusa stayed behind with his wyverns to cover the escape of those fleeing the camp, and was killed. During Honoring the Dead, his spirit is summoned and put to rest.
Olm the Wise is a rare owl formerly affiliated with the Cenarion Circle in Felwood. He is usually found flying around between Irontree Woods and Talonbranch Glade.
Old Teamster's Skull is a rare fished item, with the highest drop chance in Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

The Old Footlocker is located in the Moonbrook's school house in Westfall.
The Old Lion Statue is located east of Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge Mountains.

Olnayvi Copperpinch is a goblin vendor located in Shattrath City during the Feast of Winter Veil. He is affiliated with Smokywood Pastures and sells higher value holiday-related items. His low-value counterpart is Eebee Jinglepocket.
Old Town Thugs were humans that spawned in the Old Town in Stormwind City during The Missing Diplomat (8).

__NOTOC__ Olisarra the Kind is a high elf first aid trainer found in Dalaran. She can be found in First to Your Aid in the Magus Commerce Exchange. Around the time that Argus appeared in the sky, her first aid station was overwhelmed by Dalaran Citizens who were suffering from a strange affliction.

Old Man Barlowned is an achievement gained by completing the daily fishing quests given by Old Man Barlo. You can find him fishing northeast of Shattrath City by Silmyr Lake in Terokkar Forest.
Old Blunderbuss is part of the starting outfit for dwarf, tauren, gnome, worgen, and goblin hunters. This item is also sold by in Stormwind City for .
This feat of strength is awarded to players who still have one of the original epic mounts that were only available before patch 1.4.0.

Olivia's Pond is a small body of water located in the Stormwind City Outskirts. It is presumably named after Olivia Jayne, a draenei girl who can be seen walking along the lakeside. A small cottage is nearby, as well as a road leading to the Stormwind Embassy and the Wollerton Stead. The pond is restocked with Crystal Bass every year.
Old Faithful is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for getting Lady Naz'jar to kill one of her minions with her Geyser ability in Throne of the Tides on Heroic difficulty.

Omar Gonzalez is found on the Summer Terrace at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Since patch 5.4, he has been playing a game of Hearthstone with Scott Smith, with Zhen Zhen Wang and Ian Gerdes looking on.
Omnislash is an ability used by Mini Tyrael during a Pet Battle.

Old Whitenose is the dragon turtle mount vendor for the Tushui Pandaren, located at the pandaren camp near the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City. This vendor does not have a reputation faction and so will not provide any reputation discount. His Horde counterpart is Turtlemaster Odai.
Ollie is a pug found on the mountain of Ironforge in Dun Morogh riding on one of Dun Morogh Sledder's sleds up the hill.

To the north is the Celestial Court, the Tushui Landing is to the northwest, and eastward is the Firewalkers' Path leading to the Firewalker Ruins and points northward. The Really Skunky Beer event plays out here occasionally. Ten Skunky Brew Alementals will spawn, all with the standard alemental set of abilities. Once they have been defeated, Zhu-Gon the Sour spawns in the center of town by the well. Kill it for a decent amount of Timeless Coins. At the dock, Fin Longpaw occasionally starts fishing. If interacted with, he will fish up the kraken Karkanos. Off the shore to the southeast is a sunken hozen ship, wh
Oldus is a nightborne construct found in the city of Suramar.
Ominous Pamphlet is given by Doomsayers in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City as a precursor of the Legion Invasion‎.
__NOTOC__ Olokk the Shipbreaker is a sea giant located in the Misty Coast in Highmountain.
Omanawkwa Steelhoof is a Highmountain tauren located in Halls of Valor.

Old Tella is a Zandalari troll located in the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax attacked the city, Old Tella was cornered by the invading sethrak. He was rescued by the Speaker of the Horde and joined the fight alongside Princess Talanji. During Talanji's coronation, riots erupted in the Zocalo, and Old Tella was cowering in fear while being defended by Bri'tani.
The Old Seawall is an area on the southwestern coast of Dazar'alor in Zuldazar. Crimson Cultists with their smuggled crawgs have taken over the area and using it as a market for blood magic.
The Ominous Orb will appear after petting the cats in the house of Lady Chaton in the Court of Stars the correct amount of times as part of the Riddle of the Hivemind.
Old Rusty Keys drop from Seaspray murlocs at the Western Spray on Mechagon Island. The keys will unlock Old Rusty Chests in the area.
Old Rusty Chests are chests located at the Western Spray on Mechagon Island. They are opened with an Old Rusty Key.
Old Parchment is contained in Waterlogged Scroll Case in the eastern part of Mechagon Island.
Omnipurpose Efficient Logic Board drops from rare mobs on Mechagon Island and is a quest reward from First One's Free.
The Old Pirate Hat has a chance to drop from Congealed Oil on Mechagon Island.
Old Longtooth is a yak encountered during Island Expeditions.
The Omni Electromagnetic Amplifier drops from Insurgent Cycloids on Mechagon Island.

Olemba trees are trees native to the Draenor region of Talador, later known as Terokkar Forest. They make up the bulk of Terokkar's forests. They exude a sticky sap that flows down their bark. Their seeds are stored in tough, fist-sized cones that fall from the tree's branches once they've reached maturity, glowing with a beautiful blue light. Rakoria was interested in trying to press their oily seeds in order to extract something useful out of it, resulting in a high-quality mana oil. Olemba root also has shamanistic properties. Ros'eleth tried to send olemba seeds to the park of Stormwind City, but as it got later burned down by Deathwing, it is doubtful olemba trees can be found on Azerot
Omnipurpose Effective Logic Board has a chance to drop from the rare mobs throughout Mechagon Island.
Omnipurpose Refined Logic Board has a chance to drop from the rare mobs throughout Mechagon Island.

An Old Grimoire can be found next to the body of Hubert Lucas or Sprag Buzzboom at the Darkmaul Bridge on Exile's Reach. It details a ritual to bind a powerful voidwalker to a warlock's service. __NOTOC__

:Not to be confused with the Old Coast Path in Azsuna. The Old Coast Road is a long, narrow path that runs through much of Westfall. It begins near the Jansen Stead in the northeast, where it splits off from a larger unnamed road to snake its way west. Near Jangolode Mine, it curves off to the south and continues all the way to Moonbrook. Since the Cataclysm, the middle section of the path is broken up by the Raging Chasm.
Olfkrig the Indentured is a skeleton located in Island Expeditions.
Old Belfyr is a giant sea turtle used as transportation between Iskaara and Kiopo's island in the Azure Span. The turtle is crewed by four tuskarr. No loading screen occurs during the trip.

Onyxia's Lair is a level 80 raid dungeon located in the Wyrmbog, Dustwallow Marsh. It is home to Onyxia, the brood mother of the black dragonflight. Onyxia's Lair was originally a level 60, 40-player raid dungeon, one of two that were available upon release of World of Warcraft (the other being Molten Core). It was re-tuned as a level 80 raid dungeon in patch 3.2.2 in honor of World of Warcraft's 5-year anniversary. Like all other Wrath of the Lich King raid dungeons, it has both 10-man and 25-man modes.

While some capes provide more fire resistance, the Onyxia Scale Cloak is essential for most of the bosses in Blackwing Lair since this cloak renders the wearer prevents a powerful DoT from being applied when hit with Shadow Flame. In , the cloak is also required to open the Blazing Shadowflame Chest in Zaralek Cavern and loot the Blazing Shadowflame Cinder.
__NOTOC__ Onyxien is a nether drake found in Shattrath City.

__NOTOC__ Ontuvo is a draenei gem and recipe vendor located behind Exarch Nasuun and the Shattrath Portal to Isle of Quel'Danas on the Terrace of Light of Shattrath City. He was added with Patch 2.4.2 and duplicates Shaani's wares.

Onyxia's Elite Guards spawned in Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City when a player was on the quest The Great Masquerade. Low-level players were advised to back and away and watch rather than getting involved, or else risk a swift demise. They were originally disguised as Stormwind Royal Guards.
On a Pale Horse is a passive death knight ability, available at level 22. It increases mounted speed.

__NOTOC__ Onslaught Raven Priests are human members of the Scarlet Onslaught and the raven priest sect located in New Hearthglen in the Dragonblight. Most of them patrol around town and occasionally stop to speak to the Onslaught Footmen. During The Perfect Dissemblance, Horde players use the Banshee's Magic Mirror to copy the appearance of one of the Raven Priests and create a temporary disguise, which is subsequently used to speak to High Abbot Landgren in A Fall From Grace.
On The Rocks is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Prince Keleseth] in Utgarde Keep on Heroic difficulty without shattering any Frost Tombs.

__NOTOC__ One More Glass (also known as One Last Glass) is a shop in Dalaran that sells wine, bread, and cheese. It is located next to the Barbershop on the northeastern side of the city. On its sign there is a raven, indicating the shop is an entrance to the Uncrowned's Hall of Shadows.

Onyx Panther is a Feat of Strength rewarded for obtaining an Onyx Panther, which was only available on the Korean servers. Entries on the [http://kr.wowarmory.com korean WoW Armory] indicate that there are characters that have received it as late as February 2010, and at least as early as October 2009.

One Keg is the eastern extent of the Burlap Trail in central Kun-Lai Summit. The trailhead of the unnamed mountain pass up to Neverest Basecamp and the Valley of Emperors can be found just to the west. Grummle caravans from the Grummle Bazaar stop at One Keg before travelling west along the Burlap Trail to the Burlap Waystation and the Kota Basecamp. The Howlingwind Trail begins in town and heads northeast up to Howlingwind Cavern. From there, adventurers can head around the mouth of the cavern up an unnamed trail to reach the southeastern end of the Valley of Emperors. The inn of One Keg is the Lucky Traveller.
Onyx Bite is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Onodo is a draenei blacksmithing trainer and vendor located on Aldor Rise in Shattrath City.

__NOTOC__ The Raven Bishops are raven priests of the Scarlet Onslaught roaming Onslaught Harbor in Icecrown. They occasionally stop to cast a Blessing of the Light (tinged with shadow magic) on one of the Harbor Guards or Paladins.
Oof Brainbasher is a pygmy who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Onyx Scarabs are beetles located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Onlookers are orcs, tauren, goblins, blood elves, jungle trolls, Forsaken, pandaren, Mag'har orcs, nightborne, and Highmountain tauren.
Onyx-Imbued Breeches drop from Wrathion, the Black Emperor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
One Piece of Many is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Oneth's Clear Vision is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Oneth.
Onyx Glare-Reducers are cosmetic eyeglasses in the head slot sold for by Finn in outside the Barber Shop in the Trade District of Stormwind City or Ca'nees in the Barber Shop of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Onnesa is a dwarf located in the square just south of Stormwind Stockade in Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Ookbeard is a rare elite hozen that spawns on a small island off the Shrouded Coast in northwestern Forbidden Reach.

The One Hundred were a group of humans of the Empire of Arathor who were taught arcane magic by the high elves during the Troll Wars, becoming the first human magi in history. Their history was recorded in the Annals of the One Hundred.
Oomailiq is a tuskarr who steers the Green Island, a giant turtle, between Moa'ki Harbor and Kamagua.
Orb of the Darkmoon is an necklace that that gives bonuses to stamina, spirit, and intellect.

The Orb of Command is an orb which is used as a "shortcut" entrance to Blackwing Lair in Blackrock Mountain. It is located down the hall to the right of the entrance to Blackrock Spire. It was only usable if one had completed the quest Blackhand's Command (quest), the attunement quest for Blackwing Lair. With the revamp of Upper Blackrock Spire in patch 6.0.2, the quest was removed and so was the attunement requirement.
Ophelia Montague is a wraith banker located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity.
Orange Hakkari Bijou is a small token of power from the mobs in Zul'Gurub.

In this wing of the Caverns of Time, a group of players must defend the last Guardian , in a swamp known as The Black Morass. The Guardian Medivh, possessed by , attempts to open the Dark Portal to Draenor, while wave upon wave of dragonkin of the infinite dragonflight attempt to defeat Medivh in order to alter time and halt the invasion of Azeroth from Draenor. This time sequence is set about a few months before Warcraft I events (circa 30 years before WoW). It takes about 30 minutes to fully clear the instance, starting from triggering Medivh until the last boss is dead.

__NOTOC__ Or'Kalar is an ogre found in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. He hates Drum Fel, who defeated him years before, so Drum's wife Korin wants Or'Kalar's dead, however, several attempts made to kill him have failed. Mug'thol commands him from the Alterac Mountains. Because of this, it's unclear if Or'Kalar is with the Boulderfist clan or the Crushridge clan. However, Or'Kalar does lead the Boulderfist ogres in Stromgarde Keep, but not the entire clan.

Opaque Eye of Zul is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting. Orbital Devastation (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Flame Leviathan with 2 Orbital Defense Systems active on 25-player mode.

Oostan is large area of pygmy territory in the western part of Lost Peak's caldera, on the Lost Isles. Within the area there are three villages: Nord in the north, Sor in the west, and Ost in the south. It is from here that the pygmy witch doctors—Gaahl, Malmo, and Teloch—turn the goblin survivors into zombies and send them to attack the Town-In-A-Box. Oostan and its surroundings are completely destroyed by the volcano's eruption.

The Orb of the Shooting Star is looted from Watcher Heads in Uldum.
Orbs of the Stars are provided by Harrison Jones for Do the Honors.

Orc Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Orc archaeology sites.
Oracle Visitors are visitors that occasionally appear in the VIP section of the Darkmoon Faire Zoo.

Generally, only the islands and strips of land immediately across from Medivh need to be cleared, though a wider radius is safer until the group has a good sense of where the action will take place. Orb of Elune is provided as an objective for Power Over the Tides.

Ootasa Galehoof is a Highmountain tauren quest giver located at Talonrest in Stormheim. She and Hono Galehoof were murdered by Rax Sixtrigger and Snaggle Sixtrigger while an adventurer was off killing duskpelt worgs.
Or'ell's Power Core is a Nightborne construct's core of Or'ell.
Open Link is a Demonology warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Imp-erator (artifact trait), Maw of Shadows and Stolen Power (warlock artifact trait) traits.
Orbital Support Shredders are goblin shredders located in Stonetalon Mountains. They are summoned from Azeroth's orbit by Goblin Pump Controllers.
Optical Override Drives have a chance to drop from mobs on Mechagon Island during Ideas Can Come from Anywhere.
Orange Spineapples can be found on Island Expeditions. They heals adventurers to full health.
Optimized Adaptable Logic Board has a chance to drop from the rare mobs throughout Mechagon Island.
Optimized Effective Logic Board has a chance to drop from the rare mobs throughout Mechagon Island.

Orange Paint Filled Bladder drops from the Crazed Trogg on Mechagon Island. They can also be created with a Dredged Leather Bladder or looted from Balloon Boxes in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach.

The Orb of Deception is obtained from the Imposter anima power in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Two Orbs are located in a chamber in the Nexus of Actualization in Zereth Mortis. One can be pushed through the room, into another, causing it to slide down a passage leading to another chamber where the Template Archive and a Teleporter is located.

Oracle Stone is found inside a tree in the Moonwillow Peak in . It is used by and the Alliance commander to witness a vision of a possible future using a Clarity Elixir. After the vision ends, the stone breaks.

__NOTOC__ Orendil Broadleaf is a night elf quest giver located at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. Following the Horde invasion of the post, he was apparently the only survivor. He now tends to the Maestra's Post Sentinels, and he coordinates efforts with his apprentices to find a cure for Relara Whitemoon, a sick night elf child in Astranaar. Orendil's Retreat and its apprentices are named for him.
Orcas are a type of predatory black-and-white whales found in various Azerothian oceans, mostly around Northrend.

A small orc village was nestled in the hills around Hillsbrad Foothills. It was destroyed by the forces of Aretain Naris, and all the orcs there were massacred. The only survivor was Na'uga and her child.

Orgrimmar Revelers are orcs and jungle trolls found in Orgrimmar and Moonglade during the Lunar Festival. They also appear in Orgrimmar and Durotar during the New Year and Midsummer Fire Festival firework events.

Orgrimmar Legion camp is the name of the Horde camp stationed near Hive'Regal in Silithus. It served as the Orgrimmar Legion's base of operations. As of the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, the camp was destroyed alongside the majority of Silithus by Sargeras and his sword. Several bodies of the Orgrimmar Legion were later found, but it is unclear if the other members managed to escape or perished as well.

The Orgrimmar Legion is a battalion of orcs and jungle trolls sent from Orgrimmar to Hive'Regal in Silithus to aid the Cenarion Hold, controlled by Cenarion Circle druids. They fought silithid and aqir pouring out from bug hives. They were short on supplies and were rewarding members of the Horde with Cenarion Logistics Badges, which could be traded for rewards at Cenarion Hold. After the successful campaign, the Orgrimmar Legion apparently remained stationed in Silithus. As of the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth and the Argus Campaign, several bodies of the Orgrimmar Legion were found in the destroyed Silithus. __NOTOC__ Orders from High Command drops from Master Sergeant Pietro Zaren in Gilneas City.
Ordo is a draenei Aldor paladin trainer located in the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

The Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange is a station of the Bilgewater Cartel Rocketway, near the rear gate to the city of Orgrimmar. Many goblins previously residing in Goblin Slums, now replaced with Orgrimmar Embassy, were moved inside the building here as part of a "workforce adjustment." Allied races must be unlocked in order to see them here. The quest Return of the Highborne? acts as a breadcrumb quest from the rear gate to this location.

The Orgrimmar Rear Gate connects the city of Orgrimmar to Azshara, controlled by the Horde-allied goblins of the Bilgewater Cartel. It is set at the end of a long canyon road leading from the Valley of Honor. Ag'tor Bloodfist and Labor Captain Grabbit await adventurers here with the first quests of the Azshara storyline. Talrendis Scouts can initially be found sneaking around the vicinity at first, but as the storyline progresses, it comes under siege from Alliance forces. Despite this Horde forces, with the aid of adventurers, are able to repel the invasion. During the Legion Invasions, demons targeted the area. Allied forces cooperated by Jastor Gallywix defended the area.

Orgrimmar Bruisers are goblin guards who can be found in the Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar. Like other goblin guards, they have the ability to shoot intruders. When not on duty, the Off-Duty Bruisers can be found relaxing around the area and interacting with other off-duty NPCs. Upon establishing the Orgrimmar Embassy and the acceptance of the nightborne into the Horde, a male bruiser faked an injury in order to see Mender Jessara because he is in love with her.

Orgo Ribcrusher was an elite level 85 Isle of Conquest battlemaster located in Shattrath's Lower City during the Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest. He was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest).
The Orders from Base Camp drop from Marshal Paltrow in Windshear Valley in the Stonetalon Mountains.

The Order of the Cloud Serpent is an order of serpent riders sworn to defend the Jade Forest. They train at the Arboretum, just to the north of the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest. This order of flying warriors was founded long ago, during the Zandalari wars. Gain their favor, and they'll reveal the secrets of training a cloud serpent to become a loyal mount which the order raises from birth.
Orgrimmar Peons are orcs found in the Valley of Strength during the Siege of Orgrimmar. They also appeared in the Drag near the tree where Gamon was later captured.

Orgrokk is a mo'arg brute that appears at Windripper Peak in Highmountain during Legion Assaults. He also appeared at the Legion Invasion locations.

.]] .]] The Orcish Runes are runes in the orcish language that were written by Gul'dan as he journeyed into the Tomb of Sargeras during the Second War. Following the Third War, the night elf Maiev Shadowsong found them and was able to read them. The Tomb of Sargeras raid is peppered with these clickable runes that reset each week with every lockout. Only one player can click each rune. Upon clicking one, the rune transforms you into Gul'dan and lets you try to take down your allies. You can swipe at them with a scythe, you can hurl fireballs, and you can fire out a concentrated blast of heat, all variants of his abilities from the fight in the Nighthold. However, you retain your health pool.

The Orgrimmar Embassy is a district in Orgrimmar that serves as a meeting point for the leadership of the Horde and as headquarters for many of its allied races. The Order of Embers (or the Ember Order) is an elite organization of Kul Tiran champions tracing its origins back to the first colonization of Drustvar by the humans nearly three millennia ago. Founded to fight the Drust threat, the order has been recently revived to fight the Heartsbane Coven of witches. Members of the Order, known as Inquisitors, are highly trained individuals using a variety of techniques and weapons, some of them using the Light, and all armed with an in-depth knowledge of Drust and witch magic. The Inquisitors of the order have been successful in containing this influence, and securing the region from ruin during the Drust incursion.
Orc Demolishers are destroyed demolishers located in the Decrepit Fields in Silverpine Forest.

The Orgrimmar Barracks are a building appearing in Orgrimmar in To Tame a Land. Rexxar can hire Grunts, Troll Berserkers and Pack Beasts there. The Hall of the Brave in the Valley of Strength may be the Orgrimmar Barracks.
The Organ of Corruption is located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Organized Vial Satchel is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ Orian Darkwater is a blue dragonspawn rebel found in the Misty Vale in Thaldraszus. He was granting elemental blessings to allow his fellows to pass through barriers. When Maldra Flametongue wanted to leave the rebels, she became Orian's prisoner, and he used elemental bonds to hold her. Investigator Erima arrived to the camp in order to disrupt the Primalists and rescue Maldra, so he sent an adventurer to kill Orian. With Orian gone, she easily broke the chains. Later, Maldra replicated the same elemental magic that Orian used on her and enchanted her ring with that spell.
Order-Powered Mechblade is sold for by Gill the Drill at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.

Ornate Mithril Pants are plate legguards that provides a bonus to strength and dodge chance. These pants were originally created by the Mithril Order and can be made by Blacksmiths that are training to be Armorsmiths.

__NOTOC__ Orphan Matron Nightingale is a human located in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City. Along with her fellow matron Shellene, she runs the orphanage, raising and taking care of the various orphans, many of whose parents have been killed as a result of recent conflicts. She can be found standing just outside the entrance to the orphanage, south-east of the Cathedral of Light. Additionally, she organizes the event of Children's Week in Stormwind, in which heroes of the Alliance are encouraged to take an orphan under their wing for a short time and show them some of the wonders of Azeroth and beyond. She appears dead in the Vision of Stormwind.

Oslow's Toolbox is looted from the Sunken Chest at the bottom of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains. The chest can be found just south of the largest Murloc camp on the shore, in the middle of a cluster of boulders next to a sunken rowboat surrounded by murlocs around levels 19 and 20.
The Ornate Boots of the Sanctified are a set of plate boots that give a bonus to strength, stamina, and intellect. This is a good item for paladins.
__NOTOC__ Oruhe is a draenei stable master located on the Aldor Rise of Shattrath City.

You can trade ten (10) of these powders to Chief Researcher Kartos for the Alliance or Chief Researcher Amereldine for the Horde in the town of Halaa, Nagrand for a Halaa Research Token. __NOTOC__ Orphan Matron Mercy is a jungle troll who runs the orphanage in the Lower City in Shattrath alongside Nicole Bartlett. She serves as a quest giver during Children's Week.

The Stormwind orphanage houses the human orphans of various wars and conflicts from the recent history of Stormwind. It is run by John Turner and his wife Stephanie, but as both are busy collecting supplies or crafting clothes the orphans are cared for and overseen by Orphan Matron Nightingale and Shellene. The orphanage is located in the Cathedral Square area of the city, just south-east of the Cathedral of Light. The orphanage was originally meant to house children who had lost parents during the First and Second Wars, but also later found use for those children who survived attacks by the Scourge in the decade after. Young paladins often donated clothes to the orphanage in their quest for

In recent years night elves have learned to hate orcs, and many have developed weapons to slay these foul creatures. The orkenblade is one of the finest of these weapons, and is coveted by most night elf warriors, rangers and scouts. It is a handsome longsword, with a slender, sharp blade that shines silver in the light. The crossguard is simple but elegant, the handle wellwrapped in dark green leather, and the pommel a clean heavy disc set with a small yellow-green stone. Runes are etched along the blade, though these are only visible by moonlight. The orkenblade's scabbard is dark green leather chased in silver, and bears the night elf runes for "death" and "orc."

Ormorok the Tree-Shaper is an elemental boss living in The Nexus. Ormorok and his creations were probably captured and put into the Nexus to serve as one of the guards. Ormorok himself is the sentinel to one part of Keristrasza's prison. In the Nexus, they were subjected to massive amounts of Arcane energy daily. Over time, they were corrupted and became mad. Now, they possibly serve Malygos and the Blue Dragonflight, whether they like it or not.

Orthus Cliffwalker was the son of High Chieftain Cliffwalker and Masha Cliffwalker. During the questline in Stonetalon Mountains, he along with his parents are trying to protect Thal'darah Grove from Overlord Krom'gar's and General Grebo's false accusations. Horde adventurer finds him dead inside Thal'darah tree along with few night elven corpses. He was murdered by General Grebo, for his Krom'gar General's Insignia can be found on the Tauren's body.
